author: readiness_author
scope: Independent read-only host discovery and source/setup packet review, never native admission
outline: Read repository standards, adopted R2, actual L1 plan and canonical SQL/client owners.
Freeze criteria before author raw findings. Independently inspect bounded host executable/driver/daemon/cache/isolation metadata without connecting to a database or executing target binaries.
Compare immutable author evidence with independent observations; distinguish absence, unavailable, unsupported and unobserved facts.

Accept a concrete source launcher only if admitted supported host/runtime/identity/authentication/isolation inputs exist; otherwise assess a small exact setup/approval packet and preserve L1 NOT_EXECUTABLE.
Record exact source/review hashes, raw commands/results, factual prerequisites versus action permissions, resources/cost/bounds and owned cleanup.

criteria.expectation: Correct selected saved environment and exact repository base, no relocation or assumed host equivalence.
Exact existing PostgreSQL server/initdb/pg_ctl, client drivers, Node/Python dependencies and supported provenance are independently evidenced, not inferred from a client package or command name.
Daemon/cache observations use harmless bounded read-only metadata only; no image pull/build/launch, daemon mutation, environment/credentials read or namespace/capability change.
Isolation and authentication must protect against untrusted local peers; loopback, root, namespace-looking paths or cached tools alone do not prove containment. No localhost trust assumption.

Canonical proposed L1 counts/resources remain one fresh cluster/two exact databases/roles, bounded listeners, exact command set and original720s work/900s cleanup ceilings; no unreviewed gateway/native phases added.
Exact positive process/cluster/listener/file identity and exclusive cleanup requirements remain. UNKNOWN means HOLD; no name/port-based kill or deletion.

No current Aurora/production/customer access, DB execution/install/create, security/HBA/network/credential changes, spend or target native probes. Existing host cost remains unestimated, provider/cloud additions zero only within stated action scope.
Any approved setup request names minimum prerequisites and actions separately; no generic disconnected launcher or claim an unavailable binary/image is executable.
Raw failures and read-only limits retained, author packet exact hashes verified, source-only ACCEPT_SOURCE/HOLD separate from native gate.
